commodity: Wood-based panels: MDF, particleboard, melamine-faced board (MFB), laminate worktops

No electricity spend or GWh figures published for Ugie.

operations: Bundle of three forestry/timber operators: (1) Sappi Forests — Sappi Southern Africa's own forestry division, 405,000 ha under VP: Forestry Duane Roothman, feeds Sappi's SA pulp/paper mills; (2) York Timber Holdings Limited (JSE: YRK) — SA's largest solid wood processor, main sawmill/plywood complex in Sabie, Mpumalanga; (3) Merensky Timber (Hans Merensky Holdings) — c.65,000 ha pine/eucalyptus plantations including Singisi and Weza forests (Eastern Cape/KZN); majority stake taken up by Criterion Africa Partners with FMO backing.

No solar, wheeling or PPA figures published for any of the three entities found; sawmilling, plywood pressing and kiln-drying are continuous, energy-intensive processes typical of wheeling/PPA candidates.
